players.product: large-megawatt diesel and gas backup generator sets (with in-house Enercon enclosures/packaging) for hyperscale and colocation data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Generac's 8-K: on September 16, 2026 Generac and Amazon executed a long-term supply agreement for backup power generators for Amazon data centers; initial deliveries of backup generators are expected to total $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028 (the agreement itself is recorded on the Generac -> Amazon edge).
quarterly_data.figure: initial backup-generator deliveries expected to total $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028
